description.value: Romilano Pizza is a pizza restaurant on Renfrew Street in East Vancouver serving authentic Italian-style pies made with high-quality Italian flour, with over 16 varieties available fresh in store. The restaurant offers both delivery and walk-in takeout, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood. Catering is also available.
